description: Turn inaccessible PDFs into properly structured accessible documents.
notes: Kit fallback inlined; shared kit.js not present at build time

notes.note: Most PDFs are flat scans — gibberish to screen readers — and automated PDF/UA repair is a genuine compliance unlock. With accessibility enforcement biting (EAA and ADA pressure), universities and governments have $499/mo-shaped budgets and legal reasons to spend them. Regulatory tailwinds are the best tailwinds.
Run repair generates the repaired tag tree; zero errors.
Normalized score schema: iteration-2 worker used thesis/magic_moment/demo_legibility/value_prop/ceiling; mapped to startup/originality/quality/usefulness/tech respectively.

iteration_notes.change: Hear-the-screen-reader player narrates the document in detected order: gibberish before repair, correct reading order after
